citations.S1: SQL injection — critical.** `query = "... = '%s' ... '%s'" % (user_id, status)` builds SQL from unsanitized request input.
citations.S2: Connection/cursor never closed — high (resource leak).** `conn`/`cur` are never closed, including on the exception path
citations.S3: `order[0]` (the `id` column) is an `int`; `"Order #" + order[0]` raises `TypeError: can only concatenate str`
citations.S4: Division by zero in `average_order_value` — high.** `total / len(orders)` raises `ZeroDivisionError` when `orders` is empty
citations.S5: Money stored/summed as `float` — high (data integrity).** Floats cannot represent currency exactly
citations.S6: A negative `pct` increases the price; `pct > 100` produces a negative amount. ... Fix: validate `0 <= pct <= 100`.
citations.S7: `status` should be checked against a known enum of order statuses
citations.S10: `str(order[1])` prints `$19.9` instead of `$19.90`. Fix: format to 2 decimal places.
citations.S12: `apply_discount` doesn't round — low/medium.** Result can have many decimal places (e.g. `9.987`), which is invalid for a currency amount. Fix: quantize to cents.
citations.S13: No result bound/pagination — low.** A user with many orders returns everything in one shot
